properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 1:36PM CDT until August 9 at 2:30PM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
SVRLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Kendall County in northeastern Illinois...
Northwestern Will County in northeastern Illinois...
Southeastern Kane County in northeastern Illinois...
Southern DuPage County in northeastern Illinois...

* Until 230 PM CDT.

* At 136 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over North Aurora,
or near Aurora, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Aurora, Naperville, Bolingbrook, Wheaton, Downers Grove, Lombard,
Romeoville, Plainfield, Woodridge, Oswego, Glen Ellyn, West
Chicago, Batavia, Geneva, Yorkville, Hinsdale, Lemont, Burr Ridge,
Oak Brook, Westmont, Lisle, Darien, Montgomery, North Aurora, and
Warrenville.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
